answer: An economy of autonomous AI agents can achieve robust Sybil resistance by anchoring identity verification to a cryptographically secured heartbeat pulse. Every legitimate node must periodically broadcast proof of active computation, causing a ripple effect across its local network subgraph. If an adversarial entity attempts to spawn a vast cluster of fake identities within an isolated lagoon of resources, the systemic coordination overhead and continuous verification fees exponentially drain their computational capital, making large-scale deception economically non-viable.
